ChuckIntroText1:
WAHAHAH!

So you've come
this far!

Let me tell you,
I'm tough!

My #MON will
crush stones and shatter bones!

Watch this!
ChuckIntroText3:
There! Scared now,
are you?

What?
It has nothing to

do with #MON?
That's true!

Come on. We shall
do battle!
ChuckLossText:
Wha? Huh?
I lost?

How about that!
You're worthy of STORMBADGE!
ChuckExplainBadgeText:
STORMBADGE makes
all #MON up to

L70 obey, even
traded ones.

It also lets your
#MON use FLY

when you're not in
a battle.

Here, take this
too!
ChuckExplainTMText:
That is DYNAMIC-
PUNCH.

It doesn't always
hit, but when it

does, it causes
confusion!
ChuckAfterText:
WAHAHAH! I enjoyed
battling you!

But a loss is a
loss!

From now on, I'm
going to train 24 hours a day!
BlackbeltYoshiSeenText:
My #MON and I
are bound togeth- er by friendship.

Our bond will
never be broken!
BlackbeltYoshiAfterText:
You seem to have a
strong bond with your #MON too!
BlackbeltLaoAfterText:
Fighting #MON
are afraid of psy- chics…
BlackbeltNobSeenText:
Words are useless.
Let your fists do the talking!
BlackbeltLungSeenText:
My raging fists
will shatter your #MON!
BlackbeltLungAfterText:
My #MON lost…
My… my pride is shattered…
